title: A feature and its cost
hook: A toy redesign lowers upside and limits downside. Compare the net averages.

knows: basic arithmetic and the meaning of a percentage
doesNotKnow: Evaluate both net branches of an explicit feature trade rather than only its largest gross benefit.

misconception: Removing a feature can only lower the value of a business offer.
objective: Evaluate both net branches of an explicit feature trade rather than only its largest gross benefit.
